title: The Beat Between Doses — German Ketone Process Claims & Dole–Nyswander Maintenance, Chiral (R)-μ-Opioid Signaling (PDB 9XC6) vs. (S)-Methadone CYP2B6 Clearance & hERG IKr Blockade, QTc Correction Math & Torsades Prevention

teenKit.tldr: In 15 seconds: Methadone is sold as a 50:50 mirror-image mixture: (R)-methadone relieves opioid withdrawal at mu receptors (PDB 9XC6), while (S)-methadone blocks cardiac hERG potassium channels and relies on CYP2B6 clearance—stretching the ECG QT interval between doses.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Stereochemistry and heart-rate math save lives: using the right QTc formula (Fridericia vs. Bazett) and respecting chiral CYP2B6 accumulation prevents lethal torsades de pointes without abandoning effective addiction care.
keyTakeaways: Racemic methadone contains two enantiomers with split personalities: (R)-methadone carries ~10-fold higher mu-opioid affinity (PDB 9XC6), whereas (S)-methadone more potently blocks cardiac hERG (IKr) repolarizing channels.

Slow CYP2B6 alleles (*6/*6) or drug inhibitors preferentially slow clearance of cardiotoxic (S)-methadone and extend methadone's long terminal half-life, causing delayed accumulation days after a dose increase.
Bazett's square-root QT correction overcorrects at fast heart rates; Fridericia's cube-root formula and electrolyte (K+/Mg2+) optimization guide safe ECG monitoring.

vocab.meaning: Left- and right-handed mirror-image molecules (like (R)- and (S)-methadone) that look identical in flat formulas but fit chiral protein pockets differently.
Rapid delayed rectifier potassium channel that repolarizes heart ventricles; blocking it prolongs the QT interval.
A polymorphic ventricular tachycardia ('twisting of the points') triggered by severe QT prolongation and early afterdepolarizations.

quiz.question: Why does chiral pharmacology matter for racemic methadone safety?
options: (R)-methadone drives most mu-opioid efficacy while (S)-methadone more strongly blocks cardiac hERG channels and depends heavily on CYP2B6 clearance
(S)-methadone shortens the QT interval to zero
quiz.explanation: StereoselectiveCYP2B6 slow metabolism raises (S)-methadone plasma levels, amplifying hERG blockade and QTc prolongation.
